bootstrap.procedure: Draw ceil(n / 7) block start indices uniformly from the n units in date order, take 7 consecutive units from each (wrapping from the end to the start), truncate to n units, and recompute the effect on the resample. Excluded (missing-data) units stay in the series and are skipped when computing rates.
bootstrap.undefinedResamples: A resample with no predictor units has an undefined effect; it is dropped from the percentile calculation and the count of dropped resamples is reported.
bootstrap.ci: 95% percentile interval: the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the bootstrap effects, linear interpolation between order statistics (R quantile type 7).

prng.note: A fresh generator seeded with this value for each hypothesis.

verdictRules.order: Evaluated top to bottom; the first rule that matches decides.

proverb.text: Ring around the moon, rain soon

hypothesis.statement: In London, nights with thin high cloud, little low cloud and a bright moon above the horizon are more often followed by rain 24 to 48 hours later than nights in general.

data.modelNote: ERA5 only (0.25 deg, 1940-present). Pinned so the 1950-2024 series is homogeneous: the default best_match switches between ERA5-Land, ERA5 and ECMWF IFS (2017+), so an apparent change could be a model change rather than weather. ERA5-Land has no cloud-layer variables.
data.reanalysisCaveat: Gridded reanalysis (modelled, ~25 km cells), not station readings; it smooths local showers.

timeRules.fetchTimeZone: UTC (timezone=GMT); every timestamp is a UTC instant.
timeRules.conversion: UTC instants are converted to local wall-clock time in lab code with the IANA time zone database (Intl.DateTimeFormat).
timeRules.precipitationSemantics: The precipitation value stamped at instant t is the sum over (t - 1 h, t] (Open-Meteo: "Preceding hour sum", 0.1 mm precision). The accumulation over a local interval [a, b) is the sum of values stamped at instants t with a < t <= b.
timeRules.instantSemantics: cloud_cover, cloud_cover_low, cloud_cover_mid, cloud_cover_high and temperature_2m are instantaneous values at the stamped instant. wind_gusts_10m is taken as the value at the stamped instant as delivered.
timeRules.localDay: Local day D is the interval [00:00 D, 00:00 D+1) in local time: 24 hours normally, 23 on the spring-forward day, 25 on the fall-back day.
timeRules.dailyPrecipitation: Daily precipitation for local day D is the accumulation over local day D.
timeRules.dailyMeanTemperature: Daily mean temperature for local day D is the arithmetic mean of temperature_2m at every instant t with 00:00 D <= t < 00:00 D+1 (local).
timeRules.astronomy: Sun and moon positions come from suncalc 2.1.0 at the location coordinates; no atmospheric refraction is applied beyond what suncalc does.

unit.definition: The night starting on each local day D from 1950-01-01 to 2024-12-29 (so D+2 is inside the period).

hours.interval: hourly instants t with 22:00 D <= local(t) <= 02:00 D+1: normally 5 instants, 4 on the spring-forward night, 6 on the fall-back night

predictor.aggregation: at least one instant where every condition holds at once
predictor.crudeProxyCaveat: Halos are not observed; thin high cloud with a bright, risen moon is a crude proxy for conditions in which a halo could be seen.

hours.interval: [from, to) local (local day D+2 = 24 to 48 h after the midnight inside the night)
